ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of the latitude-longitude grid and cross-regional resource allocation routes in some regions of our country, marked with three numbers, 1, 2, and 3. No. 3 is located in the southern low-latitude area of the figure, near the Tropic of Cancer 23°26′, and is near the starting point of a route for transferring resources outward. Reasoning: The question asks to determine the main environmental problem faced by resource transfer-out area No. 3. The location of No. 3 corresponds to the humid hilly and mountainous areas of southern China. This area has much precipitation and relatively large terrain relief. If vegetation is destroyed or development is improper, the most prominent ecological and environmental problem is soil erosion.
